Tesla built a robotaxi with no steering wheel and it is already on real streets
A Tesla Cybercab moved through Austin with nobody in control of anything
How the Tesla Cybercab gets through a city with no driver and no steering wheel
caption:
This is the Tesla Cybercab, a fully autonomous car with no steering wheel, no pedals, and no human ready to take over. It navigated real streets in Austin on its own.

Most cars labeled "self-driving" still require a licensed driver in the seat. The Cybercab is the first Tesla built from scratch without any manual controls at all. The empty interior is not a design choice, it is the point. The software is the only driver.
